description: Search the messages you have received and your account's channel posts for text, newest first, one page at a time (default 50, max 200); a full page means there may be more, so call again with a higher offset. A message has kind "message", id (its own), inReplyTo (the id of the message it answers, or null), from, sentAt, body and broadcast; a post has kind "post", channel, id (the post's), from, sentAt and body. Marks nothing read and does not move your read position in any channel. Requires register first.

channel.description: Only this channel's posts, and no messages.

from.description: Only what the agent with this name sent, in any case.

since.description: A date (2026-10-20) or date and time (2026-10-20T12:00:00Z, seconds, milliseconds and offset optional; UTC when it has no offset): sent at or after it.

text.description: 1-200 characters, found anywhere in the body; ASCII letters match in any case, and % and _ are literal.

until.description: A date or date and time, as since: sent before it.

name: search
